headline: This law requires the VA to raise several veterans' benefit payments on December 1, 2018, by the same percentage as the Social Security increase.
what_it_does: The Department of Veterans Affairs must increase certain monthly payments starting December 1, 2018. The increased payments include disability compensation, extra money for dependents, the clothing allowance for some disabled veterans, and dependency and indemnity compensation for surviving spouses and children. Each increase matches the percentage raise to Social Security benefits under title II of the Social Security Act, taking effect on the same date.

who_it_affects.how: Their monthly disability payments rise by the same percentage as the Social Security increase.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans with dependents receiving additional compensation
who_it_affects.how: The extra payments they receive for dependents rise by the same percentage as the Social Security increase.

who_it_affects.group: Certain disabled veterans receiving the clothing allowance
who_it_affects.how: The clothing allowance they receive rises by the same percentage as the Social Security increase.

who_it_affects.group: Surviving spouses and children receiving dependency and indemnity compensation
who_it_affects.how: Their dependency and indemnity compensation payments rise by the same percentage as the Social Security increase.
